caption: Drishti Evidence Attribute Dictionary
description: Attributes used by the Drishti evidence-preserving normalization profile.
name: dictionary

byte_end.caption: Byte End
byte_end.description: Exclusive end offset in immutable raw evidence.

byte_start.caption: Byte Start
byte_start.description: Inclusive start offset in immutable raw evidence.

certificate_sha256.caption: Certificate SHA-256
certificate_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the canonical semantic conservation certificate.

conservation_score.caption: Conservation Score
conservation_score.description: Ratio of raw bytes explicitly classified by an approved parser.

disposition.caption: Byte Disposition
disposition.description: How a byte span was treated: mapped, structural, ignored, or unmapped.

field_lineage_list.caption: Field Lineage List
field_lineage_list.description: Byte-level lineage records for normalized fields and parser decisions.

fragment_sha256.caption: Fragment SHA-256
fragment_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the referenced raw byte span.

normalization_proof.caption: Normalization Proof
normalization_proof.description: Evidence and parser provenance for this normalized event.

normalization_revision.caption: Normalization Revision
normalization_revision.description: Monotonically increasing normalization revision for the raw event.

parser_bundle_sha256.caption: Parser Bundle SHA-256
parser_bundle_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the approved parser bundle.

parser_bundle_uid.caption: Parser Bundle ID
parser_bundle_uid.description: Stable identifier and version of the approved parser bundle.

parser_identity.caption: Parser Identity
parser_identity.description: Identity of the deterministic parser that produced the event.

raw_event_uid.caption: Raw Event ID
raw_event_uid.description: Stable identifier of the immutable raw evidence event.

raw_sha256.caption: Raw SHA-256
raw_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the exact original event bytes.

rule_uid.caption: Rule ID
rule_uid.description: Stable identifier of the extraction or transformation rule.

schema_bundle_sha256.caption: Schema Bundle SHA-256
schema_bundle_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the exact compiled OCSF contract bundle.

target_path.caption: Target Path
target_path.description: Dot-separated path of the normalized OCSF field.

transformation.caption: Transformation
transformation.description: Approved deterministic transformation applied to the source bytes.
